content.short: A 10,000 NFTs collection focused on helping real red pandas.
content.description:
Do you like red pandas? If yes, take part in helping them! Reddish Pandas is a collection of 10,000 unique NFTs, with algorithmically selected attributes, living on the Cardano Network. They are focused on helping real red pandas, by donating a great part of the sales to foundations.

Also, owning one of this amazing NFTs will give you participation in governance, royalties for merchandise selling, and lots more! Will you miss this opportunity?
